• Preparazione e distribuzione di cibo nel bistro o ristorante IKEA.
• Mantenere la vostra area di responsabilità in modo che sia sempre organizzato e accogliente e i prezzi sono scritti.
• ricezione dei pagamenti e elaborazione delle transazioni in contanti presso la cassa.
• Vedi il settore alimentare dal punto di vista dei nostri clienti: gli interni.
• Ottimizzare i processi esistenti con la propria iniziativa.
• Rispetto alle linee guida per l'igiene.

Pensi che andrebbe bene?

Abbiamo scritto sopra che vogliamo che i nostri dipendenti stiano bene.

Questo include dire “grazie”!

28 giorni di vacanza (basato su una posizione al 100%)
8 settimane di congedo parentale pagato per i padri
20 settimane di congedo parentale pagato per le madri
Prestazioni sociali molto interessanti

Parcheggio gratuito

Rivediamo le applicazioni su base continuativa e fermiamo il processo di applicazione non appena troviamo la persona giusta. Si prega di applicare il prima possibile.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Who you are

When Köttbullar meets Tilsammans – then you are at IKEA.

You love our legendary food, even if you saw it every day? Then the job at IKEA Food could be interesting for you.
People work better when they are well. At IKEA, we believe that challenges bring joy when you have fun at work and achieve goals together. We want you to feel comfortable with us and to be able to develop personally and professionally.

How do you see it? See if this suits you:
• You already have experience in a customer-oriented environment with a high volume of goods, ideally in the hospitality industry or in sales.
• You like direct contact with customers: inside, like to be among people and can offer an excellent service.
• You are able to perform standing work for longer periods of time.
• You enjoy working efficiently in a team, but you also take responsibility for your own work.
• You want to keep evolving.
• You feel comfortable in a highly dynamic environment and can also deal with challenging situations.
• You speak fluent German and understand English. Knowledge of another national language is an advantage.
• You are flexible and can work every Saturday in shifts of up to 8 hours.
• You ideally have computer skills, especially in MS Office.

You are responsible for

These tasks await you:

Welcome customers in an inviting and courteous way based on IKEA values.
• Ensure that the food, drinks and products available are of the highest quality and freshness and are presented in an appealing manner.
• Preparation and distribution of food in the IKEA bistro or restaurant.
• Maintain your area of responsibility so that it is always organized and welcoming and the prices are written.
• receiving payments and processing cash transactions at the cash desk.
• View the food sector from the point of view of our customers:inners.
• Optimize the existing processes with your own initiative.
• Compliance with hygiene guidelines.

Do you think that would fit?

We wrote above that we want our employees to be well.

This includes saying “thank you”!

Our thanks:

28 days of vacation (based on a 100% position)
8 weeks of paid parental leave for fathers
20 weeks of paid parental leave for mothers
Very attractive social benefits
15% discount on your purchase – in every IKEA store
Are you coming with the public transport? We pay between 85% and 100% of the subscription
Free parking
Unlimited access to the LinkedIn learning platform
Cheap and healthy meals in the canteen (CHF 4.50 for meat and CHF 3.50 for vegi dishes)
Bonus payments for all employees

At IKEA, there are many different ways to develop. We encourage and encourage our employees to try out different tasks, to switch between functions or to go abroad. Please submit your complete application online and be aware that we cannot consider documents by e-mail or post.

That would be it of us.

That was a lot of info now. We would love to know more about you. Just click on “Apply now” and go.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and stop the application process as soon as we find the right person. Please apply as soon as possible.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Qui vous êtes

Aidez les gens à se sentir bien, à faire leurs choix plus faciles et, bien sûr, à vendre des produits IKEA. Ça te va ? On dirait que tu devrais continuer à lire.

Les gens travaillent mieux quand ils vont bien. Chez IKEA, nous croyons que les défis apportent de la joie quand vous vous amusez au travail et atteindre des objectifs ensemble. • Le contact quotidien avec de nombreuses personnes différentes vous rend amusant.
• Vous êtes expérimenté dans l'utilisation de l'ordinateur et pouvez rapidement vous familiariser avec de nouveaux programmes.
• Vous travaillez de façon indépendante et avez la gestion du temps sous contrôle.
• Vous parlez l'allemand sûr et la connaissance de l'anglais est un avantage.
• Vous êtes prêt à travailler à partir de Mo-Sa à la fois tôt et tard.

Vous êtes responsable

Ces tâches vous attendent :

• Formez activement l'expérience d'achat IKEA.
•Conseiller les clients sur leurs achats et assurer leur satisfaction.
• Connaître toute la gamme de services et les offrir aux visiteurs.
• Prenez la responsabilité de votre zone commerciale.
•Travailler avec d'autres départements pour assurer l'expérience d'achat globale.
• Avec l'équipe logistique, garantir la disponibilité des produits.
• Planification des solutions intérieures.

Tu crois que ça irait ?

Nous avons écrit plus haut que nous voulons que nos employés soient bien.

· 28 jours de congé (sur la base d'une allocation de 100 %)
· 8 semaines de congé parental payé pour les pères, 20 semaines de congé parental payé pour les mères
· Prestations sociales très attractives
· 15% de réduction sur votre achat – dans chaque magasin IKEA
· Vous venez avec les transports publics? Nous payons entre 85% et 100% de l'abonnement
· Parking gratuit
· Accès illimité à la plateforme d'apprentissage LinkedIn
Repas pas chers et sains dans la cantine (CHF 4,50 pour la viande et CHF 3,50 pour les plats vegi)
· Primes versées à tous les employés

Veuillez soumettre votre candidature complète en ligne et être conscient que nous ne pouvons pas considérer les documents par courriel ou par la poste.

Ce serait à nous.

C'était beaucoup d'infos. Nous aimerions en savoir plus sur vous. Il suffit de cliquer sur "Appliquer maintenant" et aller. Nous examinons les demandes de façon continue et arrêtons le processus de demande dès que nous trouvons la bonne personne. Veuillez postuler dès que possible.

Chi sei

Siamo alla ricerca di dipendenti nel servizio clienti che godono di stare in piedi dai nostri clienti con consigli e azioni e offrendo loro la migliore esperienza di shopping possibile. Grazie a voi, i nostri clienti non solo visiteranno IKEA con un sorriso, inoltre lasceranno i nostri negozi con un sorriso e non vediamo l'ora di tornare.

• Hai un forte orientamento di servizio, un modo amichevole e una buona sensazione per i desideri dei clienti.
• Hai sempre una risposta alle richieste e una soluzione a qualsiasi problema – non importa quanto possa essere stressante la situazione.
• Hai un tocco per avere a che fare con le persone e godere di offrire ai nostri clienti la migliore esperienza di shopping possibile.
• Hai una buona conoscenza del tedesco in parola e scrittura e sono fiducioso nel trattare con il PC. L'inglese è un vantaggio.
• Lei è numerico, può gestire bene i soldi e sentirsi a proprio agio sul computer.
• Hai una passione per l'arredamento domestico e il marchio IKEA e non vedo l'ora di conoscere la gamma di prodotti IKEA e le opzioni di servizio in dettaglio.
• Ti senti al sicuro nel trattare la lingua inglese, in modo da poter essere sempre indirizzato da clienti internazionali.

Tu sei responsabile

• Consigliare e badare ai clienti e incontrarli sempre con un sorriso amichevole:
• In cambio: Sulla base delle nostre linee guida interne, trovare soluzioni veloci, semplici e orientate al cliente per tutte le sfide.

Pensi che andrebbe bene?

Vogliamo che i nostri dipendenti facciano bene.

Questo include dire “grazie”!

Il nostro ringraziamento:

· 28 giorni di vacanza (basato su un'indennità del 100%)
· 20 settimane di congedo parentale pagato per le madri, 8 settimane di congedo parentale pagato per i padri.
· Vantaggi sociali molto attraenti
· 15% di sconto sul vostro acquisto – in ogni negozio IKEA
· Viene con i mezzi pubblici? Paghiamo tra l'85% al 100% dell'abbonamento annuale
· Parcheggio gratuito
· Accesso illimitato alla piattaforma di apprendimento LinkedIn
Pasti economici e salutari nella mensa (CHF 4.50 per la carne e CHF 3.50 per i piatti vegi)
· Bonus per tutti i dipendenti

A IKEA, ci sono molti modi diversi per sviluppare. Incoraggiamo e incoraggiamo i nostri dipendenti a provare diversi compiti, a passare tra funzioni o andare all'estero. Si prega di inviare la vostra applicazione completa on-line ed essere consapevoli che non possiamo prendere in considerazione documenti via e-mail o posta.
Siamo noi.
Sono state molte informazioni. Ci piacerebbe sapere di più su di te. Basta cliccare su “Applica ora” e andare. Rivediamo le applicazioni su base continuativa e arrestiamo il processo di applicazione non appena troviamo la persona giusta. Si prega di applicare il prima possibile.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Who you are

We are looking for employees in customer service who enjoy standing by our customers with advice and deeds and offering them the best possible shopping experience. Thanks to you, our customers will not only visit IKEA with a smile, they will also leave our stores with a smile and look forward to coming back.

• You have a strong service orientation, a friendly manner and a good feeling for the wishes of customers.
• You always have an answer to requests and a solution to any problem – no matter how stressful the situation may be.
• You have a flair for dealing with people and enjoy offering our customers the best possible shopping experience.
• You have very good knowledge of German in word and writing and are confident in dealing with the PC. English is an advantage.
• You are numerical, can handle money well and feel comfortable on the computer.
• You have a passion for home furnishings and the IKEA brand and look forward to getting to know the IKEA product range and service options in detail.
• You feel safe in dealing with the English language, so that you can always be addressed by international customers.

You are responsible for

• Advise and look after customers and always meet them with a friendly smile:
• In exchange: Based on our internal guidelines, find fast, uncomplicated and customer-oriented solutions for all challenges.

Do you think that would fit?

We want our employees to do well.

This includes saying “thank you”!

Our thanks:

· 28 holiday days (based on a 100% allowance)
· 20 weeks paid parental leave for mothers, 8 weeks paid parental leave for fathers.
· Very attractive social benefits
· 15% discount on your purchase – in every IKEA store
· Are you coming with the public transport? We pay between 85% to 100% of the annual subscription
· Free parking
· Unlimited access to the LinkedIn learning platform
Cheap and healthy meals in the canteen (CHF 4.50 for meat and CHF 3.50 for vegi dishes)
· Bonus payments for all employees

At IKEA, there are many different ways to develop. We encourage and encourage our employees to try out different tasks, to switch between functions or to go abroad. Please submit your complete application online and be aware that we cannot consider documents by e-mail or post.
That would be it of us.
That was a lot of info. We would love to know more about you. Just click on “Apply now” and go. We review applications on an ongoing basis and stop the application process as soon as we find the right person. Please apply as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
Company description
 Inter IKEA Group brings together three core businesses: Retail Concept, Range and Supply. The core business Supply include e.g. business units IKEA Industry and IKEA Components. Together we work constantly to improve the IKEA home furnishing offer and make it more accessible for the many people. IKEA Supply is responsible for sourcing, manufacturing, transporting, storing, and supplying the global IKEA range of furniture, furnishings as well as food. The Legal & Governance function of core business IKEA Supply provides legal advice within a wide spectrum of areas.

Job description
 We are looking to strengthen our legal support to core business Supply, with focus on wholesale related activities for Inter IKEA Group, by recruiting a skilled and experienced Legal Counsel to join our team.
 As Legal Counsel , you will be a trusted adviser to our wholesale business, providing pragmatic, business-oriented legal support across our international purchasing, distribution and sales activities. You will work in a truly global environment, partnering with colleagues across Supply and Inter IKEA Group within legal, purchasing, logistics, finance and tax. In this role you will:

• Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements supporting wholesale operations, including supply, purchasing, distribution, transport, logistics and warehousing arrangements.

• Advise the business on cross-border sale of goods, international trade terms, title transfer and delivery risk.

• Support purchasing and sourcing teams on transport and distribution service contracts globally.

• Provide legal guidance on intra-group agreements and the flow of goods between supply service entities and franchisees.

• Advise on regulatory and compliance matters relevant to wholesale and supply activities, including customs, trade compliance, sanctions and product-related requirements.

• Manage and mitigate legal risk in commercial disputes and support the resolution of claims relating to supply, quality and delivery.

• Instruct and coordinate external counsel across multiple jurisdictions, managing scope, quality and cost.

• Contribute to the development of legal templates, playbooks and ways of working that enable the business to move quickly and safely.

Qualification
 In order to successfully fill this position, the IKEA values reflect upon your values, you share the IKEA Vision and Business Idea, and you bring:

• Law degree with several years' post-qualification experience gained in-house and/or in a reputable law firm, with a clear focus on commercial, supply chain or wholesale-related work.

• Several years of IKEA experience in contracting and organisational structure.

• Solid knowledge of international sale of goods, maritime- and road transport, commercial contracting and cross-border trade.

• Experience with distribution (supply) agreements in franchise set ups.

• Experience from logistics and food.

• Experience advising a global business and comfort operating across multiple legal systems and cultures.

• The ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, practical advice for a commercial audience.

• Strong drafting and negotiation skills, sound judgement and a genuine sense of ownership.

• A collaborative, down-to-earth working style that fits our values-driven culture.

• Successful in building trustful relations in multicultural environments and high level of integrity.

• Driven team player who can work independently as well.

• Leadership experience.

• Pragmatic, solution-oriented, hands-on and cost-conscious.

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

More Information
 At IKEA, we continuously look for better ways of working, following our vision to create a better everyday life for the many people. It is in our culture to work together and to be open, straightforward and inclusive. If this sounds like an environment you could enjoy working in, we are looking forward receiving your CV and Cover Letter (in English) at the latest 31 October 2026 . Applications are screened continuously, and interviews are conducted on a rolling basis.
 For further information about the role please contact the recruiting manager Magnus Holmquist (email: magnus.holmquist@inter.ikea.com). For questions about the recruitment process please contact the People & Culture Leader Anna-Carin Nicolini ( anna-carin.nicolini@inter.ikea.com ).

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione della Società
Inter IKEA Group riunisce tre principali aziende: Retail Concept, Range e Supply. Il core business Supply include ad esempio business unit IKEA Industry e componenti IKEA. Insieme lavoriamo costantemente per migliorare l'offerta di arredamento casa IKEA e renderlo più accessibile per le molte persone. IKEA Supply è responsabile di approvvigionamento, produzione, trasporto, stoccaggio e fornitura della gamma globale IKEA di mobili, arredi e cibo. La funzione Legal & Governance di core business IKEA Supply fornisce consulenza legale all'interno di un ampio spettro di aree.

Descrizione del lavoro
Stiamo cercando di rafforzare il nostro supporto legale al core business Supply, con l'attenzione sulle attività connesse all'ingrosso per Inter IKEA Group, reclutando un consulente legale esperto e qualificato per unirsi al nostro team.
In qualità di consulente legale, sarai un consulente affidabile per il nostro business all'ingrosso, fornendo un supporto legale pragmatico e orientato al business attraverso le nostre attività di acquisto, distribuzione e vendita internazionali. Potrai lavorare in un ambiente veramente globale, collaborando con colleghi in tutto il Gruppo di Fornitura e Inter IKEA all'interno di legale, acquisto, logistica, finanza e tassa. In questo ruolo sarete:

• Progetto, revisione e negoziazione di una vasta gamma di accordi commerciali che sostengono le operazioni all'ingrosso, tra cui fornitura, acquisto, distribuzione, trasporto, logistica e sistemi di stoccaggio.

• Consigliare l'attività di vendita transfrontaliera di merci, termini di commercio internazionale, trasferimento titolo e rischio di consegna.

• Sostenere l'acquisto e l'approvvigionamento di squadre sui contratti di trasporto e distribuzione a livello globale.

• Fornire indicazioni legali sugli accordi intragruppo e il flusso di merci tra enti di servizio di fornitura e franchisees.

• Consultare le questioni regolamentari e di conformità relative alle attività all'ingrosso e all'offerta, comprese le dogane, la conformità commerciale, le sanzioni e i requisiti relativi ai prodotti.

• Gestire e mitigare il rischio legale in controversie commerciali e sostenere la risoluzione dei reclami relativi a fornitura, qualità e consegna.

• Istruire e coordinare il consulente esterno attraverso più giurisdizioni, la gestione dello scopo, la qualità e i costi.

• Contribuisci allo sviluppo di modelli legali, playbook e modi di lavoro che permettono al business di muoversi in modo rapido e sicuro.

Qualificazione
Al fine di riempire con successo questa posizione, i valori IKEA riflettono sui vostri valori, si condivide la Vision IKEA e Idea Business, e si porta:

• Laurea legale con esperienza post-qualificazione di diversi anni acquisita in-house e/o in uno studio legale rispettabile, con una chiara focalizzazione sul commercio, catena di fornitura o lavoro all'ingrosso.

• Diversi anni di esperienza IKEA nella struttura contrattuale e organizzativa.

• Conoscenza solida della vendita internazionale di merci, trasporti marittimi e stradali, contratti commerciali e commercio transfrontaliero.

• Esperienza con gli accordi di distribuzione (fornitura) in franchising istituito.

• Esperienza dalla logistica e dal cibo.

• Esperienza consigliando un business globale e comfort operativo attraverso più sistemi legali e culture.

• La capacità di tradurre questioni legali complesse in una consulenza chiara e pratica per un pubblico commerciale.

• Forte capacità di redazione e negoziazione, giudizio sonoro e un senso di proprietà autentico.

• Uno stile di lavoro collaborativo e a terra che si adatta alla nostra cultura basata sui valori.

• Successo nella costruzione di relazioni fiduciose in ambienti multiculturali e alto livello di integrità.

• Giocatore di squadra guidato che può lavorare indipendentemente pure.

• Esperienza di leadership.

• Pragmatico, orientato alla soluzione, pratico e conveniente.

• Fluenza in inglese, sia scritta che parlata.

Maggiori informazioni
A IKEA, cerchiamo continuamente migliori modi di lavorare, seguendo la nostra visione per creare una vita quotidiana migliore per le molte persone. È nella nostra cultura lavorare insieme e essere aperto, diretto e inclusivo. Se questo suona come un ambiente in cui si può godere di lavorare, siamo in attesa di ricevere il vostro CV e lettera di copertura (in inglese) al più tardi 31 ottobre 2026 . Le applicazioni sono proiettate continuamente, e le interviste sono condotte su base rolling.
Per ulteriori informazioni sul ruolo si prega di contattare il responsabile di reclutamento Magnus Holmquist (email: magnus.holmquist@inter.ikea.com). descriptionByLocale.en:
Company description
Inter IKEA Group brings together three core businesses: Retail Concept, Range and Supply. The core business Supply include e.g. business units IKEA Industry and IKEA Components. Together we work constantly to improve the IKEA home furnishing offer and make it more accessible for the many people. IKEA Supply is responsible for sourcing, manufacturing, transporting, storing, and supplying the global IKEA range of furniture, furnishings as well as food. The Legal & Governance function of core business IKEA Supply provides legal advice within a wide spectrum of areas.

Job description
We are looking to strengthen our legal support to core business Supply, with focus on wholesale related activities for Inter IKEA Group, by recruiting a skilled and experienced Legal Counsel to join our team.
As Legal Counsel , you will be a trusted adviser to our wholesale business, providing pragmatic, business-oriented legal support across our international purchasing, distribution and sales activities. You will work in a truly global environment, partnering with colleagues across Supply and Inter IKEA Group within legal, purchasing, logistics, finance and tax. In this role you will:

• Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements supporting wholesale operations, including supply, purchasing, distribution, transport, logistics and warehousing arrangements.

• Advise the business on cross-border sale of goods, international trade terms, title transfer and delivery risk.

• Support purchasing and sourcing teams on transport and distribution service contracts globally.

• Provide legal guidance on intra-group agreements and the flow of goods between supply service entities and franchisees.

• Advise on regulatory and compliance matters relevant to wholesale and supply activities, including customs, trade compliance, sanctions and product-related requirements.

• Manage and mitigate legal risk in commercial disputes and support the resolution of claims relating to supply, quality and delivery.

• Instruct and coordinate external counsel across multiple jurisdictions, managing scope, quality and cost.

• Contribute to the development of legal templates, playbooks and ways of working that enable the business to move quickly and safely.

Qualification
In order to successfully fill this position, the IKEA values reflect upon your values, you share the IKEA Vision and Business Idea, and you bring:

• Law degree with several years' post-qualification experience gained in-house and/or in a reputable law firm, with a clear focus on commercial, supply chain or wholesale-related work.

• Several years of IKEA experience in contracting and organisational structure.

• Solid knowledge of international sale of goods, maritime- and road transport, commercial contracting and cross-border trade.

• Experience with distribution (supply) agreements in franchise set ups.

• Experience from logistics and food.

• Experience advising a global business and comfort operating across multiple legal systems and cultures.

• The ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, practical advice for a commercial audience.

• Strong drafting and negotiation skills, sound judgement and a genuine sense of ownership.

• A collaborative, down-to-earth working style that fits our values-driven culture.

• Successful in building trustful relations in multicultural environments and high level of integrity.

• Driven team player who can work independently as well.

• Leadership experience.

• Pragmatic, solution-oriented, hands-on and cost-conscious.

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

More Information
At IKEA, we continuously look for better ways of working, following our vision to create a better everyday life for the many people. It is in our culture to work together and to be open, straightforward and inclusive. If this sounds like an environment you could enjoy working in, we are looking forward receiving your CV and Cover Letter (in English) at the latest 31 October 2026 . Applications are screened continuously, and interviews are conducted on a rolling basis.
For further information about the role please contact the recruiting manager Magnus Holmquist (email: magnus.holmquist@inter.ikea.com). For questions about the recruitment process please contact the People & Culture Leader Anna-Carin Nicolini ( anna-carin.nicolini@inter.ikea.com ).
descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung des Unternehmens
Die Inter IKEA Group vereint drei Kerngeschäfte: Retail Concept, Range und Supply. Das Kerngeschäft Supply umfasst z.B. die Geschäftseinheiten IKEA Industry und IKEA Components. Gemeinsam arbeiten wir ständig daran, das IKEA Einrichtungsangebot zu verbessern und es für die vielen Menschen zugänglicher zu machen. IKEA Supply ist für die Beschaffung, Herstellung, den Transport, die Lagerung und die Lieferung der globalen IKEA-Reihe von Möbeln, Einrichtungsgegenständen sowie Lebensmitteln verantwortlich. Die Legal & Governance-Funktion des Kerngeschäfts IKEA Supply bietet Rechtsberatung in einem breiten Spektrum von Bereichen.

Stellenbeschreibung
Wir wollen unsere rechtliche Unterstützung für das Kerngeschäft Supply mit Schwerpunkt auf Großhandelsaktivitäten für die Inter IKEA Group stärken, indem wir einen qualifizierten und erfahrenen Rechtsberater für unser Team gewinnen.
Als Rechtsberater sind Sie ein zuverlässiger Berater unseres Großhandelsgeschäfts und bieten pragmatische, geschäftsorientierte rechtliche Unterstützung bei unseren internationalen Einkaufs-, Vertriebs- und Vertriebsaktivitäten. Sie arbeiten in einem wirklich globalen Umfeld und arbeiten mit Kollegen der Supply und Inter IKEA Group in den Bereichen Recht, Einkauf, Logistik, Finanzen und Steuern zusammen. In dieser Rolle werden Sie:

• Ausarbeitung, Überprüfung und Verhandlung einer breiten Palette von Handelsvereinbarungen zur Unterstützung des Großhandels, einschließlich Liefer-, Einkaufs-, Vertriebs-, Transport-, Logistik- und Lagervereinbarungen.

• Beratung des Unternehmens in Bezug auf den grenzüberschreitenden Verkauf von Waren, internationale Handelsbedingungen, Eigentumsübertragung und Lieferrisiko.

• Unterstützen Sie Einkaufs- und Beschaffungsteams bei Transport- und Vertriebsdienstleistungsverträgen weltweit.

• Bereitstellung rechtlicher Leitlinien für gruppeninterne Vereinbarungen und den Warenfluss zwischen Versorgungsdienstleistern und Franchisenehmern.

• Beratung in Regulierungs- und Compliance-Fragen, die für Großhandels- und Lieferaktivitäten relevant sind, einschließlich Zoll, Trade Compliance, Sanktionen und produktbezogenen Anforderungen.

• Verwalten und mindern Sie rechtliche Risiken in Handelsstreitigkeiten und unterstützen Sie die Beilegung von Ansprüchen in Bezug auf Lieferung, Qualität und Lieferung.

• Instruieren und koordinieren Sie externe Beratung über mehrere Jurisdiktionen hinweg und verwalten Sie Umfang, Qualität und Kosten.

• Tragen Sie zur Entwicklung von gesetzlichen Vorlagen, Spielbüchern und Arbeitsweisen bei, die es dem Unternehmen ermöglichen, sich schnell und sicher zu bewegen.

Qualifikation
Um diese Position erfolgreich zu besetzen, reflektieren die IKEA-Werte Ihre Werte, Sie teilen die IKEA Vision und Geschäftsidee und bringen:

• Jurastudium mit mehrjähriger Erfahrung nach der Qualifikation, die intern und / oder in einer renommierten Anwaltskanzlei erworben wurde, mit einem klaren Fokus auf kommerzielle, Lieferketten- oder Großhandelsarbeiten.

• Mehrjährige IKEA Erfahrung in der Auftrags- und Organisationsstruktur.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse des internationalen Warenverkaufs, des See- und Straßenverkehrs, der gewerblichen Auftragsvergabe und des grenzüberschreitenden Handels.

• Erfahrung mit Vertriebs- (Liefer-)Vereinbarungen in Franchise-Setups.

• Erfahrung aus Logistik und Essen.

• Erfahrung in der Beratung eines globalen Unternehmens und Komfort, der in mehreren Rechtssystemen und Kulturen tätig ist.

• Die Fähigkeit, komplexe rechtliche Fragen in klare, praktische Ratschläge für ein kommerzielles Publikum zu übersetzen.

• Starkes Redaktions- und Verhandlungsgeschick, gutes Urteilsvermögen und ein echtes Verantwortungsgefühl.

• Ein kollaborativer, bodenständiger Arbeitsstil, der zu unserer werteorientierten Kultur passt.

• Erfolgreich beim Aufbau vertrauensvoller Beziehungen in multikulturellen Umgebungen und hoher Integrität.

• Fahrerischer Teamplayer, der auch unabhängig arbeiten kann.

• Führungserfahrung.

• Pragmatisch, lösungsorientiert, praxis- und kostenbewusst.

• fließend Englisch, sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen.

Mehr Informationen
Bei IKEA suchen wir kontinuierlich nach besseren Arbeitsweisen und folgen unserer Vision, einen besseren Alltag für die vielen Menschen zu schaffen. Es liegt in unserer Kultur, zusammenzuarbeiten und offen, unkompliziert und inklusiv zu sein. Wenn dies nach einer Umgebung klingt, in der Sie gerne arbeiten könnten, freuen wir uns auf Ihren Lebenslauf und Ihr Anschreiben (auf Englisch) spätestens am 31. Oktober 2026. Bewerbungen werden kontinuierlich gescreent und Interviews laufend geführt.
Für weitere Informationen über die Rolle wenden Sie sich bitte an den Recruiting Manager Magnus Holmquist (E-Mail: magnus.holmquist@inter.ikea.com). Bei Fragen zum Rekrutierungsprozess wenden Sie sich bitte an die People & Culture Leader Anna-Carin Nicolini (anna-carin.nicolini@inter.ikea.com).
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Désignation de l'entreprise
Le groupe Inter IKEA regroupe trois entreprises principales : Retail Concept, Range and Supply. L'approvisionnement de base comprend par exemple les unités d'affaires IKEA Industrie et IKEA Composants. Ensemble, nous travaillons constamment pour améliorer l'offre d'ameublement de maison IKEA et la rendre plus accessible pour les nombreuses personnes. IKEA Supply est responsable de l'approvisionnement, de la fabrication, du transport, du stockage et de la fourniture de la gamme mondiale IKEA de mobilier, d'ameublement et de nourriture. La fonction juridique et gouvernance des activités principales IKEA Supply fournit des conseils juridiques dans un large éventail de domaines.

Description du poste
Nous cherchons à renforcer notre soutien juridique à l'approvisionnement de base en mettant l'accent sur les activités liées à la vente en gros pour le Groupe Inter IKEA, en recrutant un conseiller juridique qualifié et expérimenté pour rejoindre notre équipe.
En tant que conseiller juridique, vous serez un conseiller de confiance pour notre commerce de gros, fournissant un soutien juridique pragmatique et orienté vers l'entreprise dans nos activités internationales d'achat, de distribution et de vente. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement véritablement mondial, en partenariat avec des collègues de l'ensemble du Groupe Approvisionnement et Inter IKEA dans les domaines juridique, des achats, de la logistique, des finances et de la fiscalité. Dans ce rôle, vous:

• Ébauche, examen et négociation d'un large éventail d'accords commerciaux à l'appui des opérations de gros, y compris les accords d'approvisionnement, d'achat, de distribution, de transport, de logistique et d'entreposage.

• Conseiller l'entreprise sur la vente transfrontière de marchandises, les conditions du commerce international, le transfert de propriété et le risque de livraison.

• Soutenir les équipes d'achat et d'approvisionnement sur les contrats de services de transport et de distribution à l'échelle mondiale.

• Fournir des conseils juridiques sur les accords intragroupe et la circulation des biens entre les entités de services de fourniture et les franchisés.

• Conseiller sur les questions de réglementation et de conformité concernant les activités de gros et de fourniture, y compris les douanes, le respect du commerce, les sanctions et les exigences liées aux produits.

• Gérer et atténuer les risques juridiques dans les litiges commerciaux et appuyer le règlement des réclamations relatives à l'offre, à la qualité et à la livraison.

• Instruisez et coordonnez des conseils externes dans plusieurs administrations, en gérant la portée, la qualité et les coûts.

• Contribuer à l'élaboration de modèles juridiques, de livres de lecture et de méthodes de travail qui permettent à l'entreprise de se déplacer rapidement et en toute sécurité.

Compétence
Afin de remplir avec succès ce poste, les valeurs IKEA réfléchissent à vos valeurs, vous partagez la vision IKEA et l'idée d'affaires, et vous apportez:

• Diplôme de droit avec plusieurs années d'expérience postqualification acquise à l'interne et/ou dans un cabinet d'avocats réputé, avec un accent clair sur le commerce, la chaîne d'approvisionnement ou les travaux liés à la vente en gros.

• Plusieurs années d'expérience IKEA dans la passation de marchés et la structure organisationnelle.

• Connaissance approfondie de la vente internationale de marchandises, des transports maritimes et routiers, des contrats commerciaux et des échanges transfrontaliers.

• Expérience des accords de distribution (approvisionnement) dans les franchises établies.

• Expérience de la logistique et de la nourriture.

• Expérience conseil d'une entreprise mondiale et confort fonctionnant à travers plusieurs systèmes juridiques et cultures.

• La capacité de traduire des questions juridiques complexes en conseils clairs et pratiques pour un public commercial.

• De solides compétences en rédaction et en négociation, un bon jugement et un véritable sentiment d'appropriation.

• Un style de travail collaboratif à la terre qui correspond à notre culture axée sur les valeurs.

• Réussir à établir des relations de confiance dans des environnements multiculturels et un haut niveau d'intégrité.

• Joueur d'équipe entraîné qui peut travailler indépendamment aussi bien.

• Expérience en leadership.

• Pragmatique, orientée vers la solution, pratique et conscient des coûts.

• Connaissance de l'anglais, écrit et parlé.

Informations supplémentaires
Chez IKEA, nous cherchons continuellement de meilleures façons de travailler, suivant notre vision pour créer une meilleure vie quotidienne pour les nombreuses personnes. C'est dans notre culture de travailler ensemble et d'être ouvert, direct et inclusif. Si cela ressemble à un environnement dans lequel vous pourriez aimer travailler, nous attendons avec impatience de recevoir votre CV et lettre de présentation (en anglais) au plus tard le 31 octobre 2026 . Les demandes sont examinées de façon continue et les entrevues sont menées en continu.
Pour de plus amples informations sur ce rôle, veuillez contacter le responsable du recrutement Magnus Holmquist (courriel : magnus.holmquist@inter.ikea.com). Pour toute question sur le processus de recrutement, veuillez contacter le chef du groupe People & Culture Anna-Carin Nicolini ( anna-carin.nicolini@inter.ikea.com ).
